title: AV Club
description: Write a program that reads user input until an empty line. For each non-empty string, the program splits the string by spaces ` ` and then prints the pieces that contain `av`, each on a new line.

paragraphs: Write a program that reads user input until an empty line. For each non-empty string, the program splits the string by spaces ` ` and then prints the pieces that contain `av`, each on a new line.
